example.zh: 这家网店满一百元就免运费，所以我一般会凑够了再下单。
example.en: This online shop offers free shipping on orders over 100 yuan, so I usually add items until I reach that before ordering.

quiz.zh: 东西本身不贵，可是寄到国外的运费比商品还贵。
quiz.en: The item itself isn't expensive, but shipping it abroad costs more than the goods.

example.zh: 刚进入职场的年轻人，最需要学会的是怎么与人沟通。
example.en: What young people who have just entered the working world most need to learn is how to communicate with others.

quiz.zh: 她在职场打拼了十年，终于当上了部门经理。
quiz.en: She worked hard in the working world for ten years and finally became a department manager.

中.gloss: to hit (a target); to be hit by; to win (a prize)

example.zh: 他一箭射中了靶心，观众都鼓起掌来。
example.en: He hit the bullseye with one arrow, and the audience all began to applaud.

quiz.zh: 他买了十年彩票，今天终于中了一等奖。
quiz.en: He has bought lottery tickets for ten years, and today he finally won first prize.

该.indonesian: tersebut; itu (formal, merujuk hal yang baru disebut)

example.zh: 警方表示，该男子已于昨晚被抓获。
example.en: Police said the man was caught last night.

quiz.zh: 这家公司去年推出了一款新手机，该产品上市三个月就卖出了一百万台。
quiz.en: The company launched a new phone last year; the product sold a million units within three months of going on sale.

成.gloss: one tenth; ten percent (in proportions, e.g. three tenths = 30%)

example.zh: 今年的粮食产量比去年增加了两成。
example.en: This year's grain output rose by 20% over last year.

quiz.zh: 调查显示，班里有七成的学生每天睡眠不足八小时。
quiz.en: A survey shows that 70% of the students in the class sleep less than eight hours a day.

example.zh: 这座大桥始建于1990年，是当地最有名的建筑。
example.en: This bridge was first built in 1990 and is the most famous structure in the area.

quiz.zh: 他毕业于北京大学，现在在一家外企工作。
quiz.en: He graduated from Peking University and now works at a foreign company.

example.zh: 这个地方风景很美，周末来玩的人特别多。
example.en: The scenery here is beautiful, and lots of people come on weekends.

quiz.zh: 你觉得这篇文章还有哪些地方需要修改？
quiz.en: Which parts of this article do you think still need revising?

结果.gloss: to bear fruit; to produce fruit

example.zh: 院子里那棵苹果树种了三年，今年终于结果了。
example.en: The apple tree in the yard was planted three years ago, and this year it finally bore fruit.

quiz.zh: 这些葡萄树刚种下去，至少要等两年才能结果。
quiz.en: These grapevines were just planted; it will take at least two years before they bear fruit.

求.gloss: to request; to beg; to seek

example.zh: 他求了我半天，我才答应帮他这个忙。
example.en: He begged me for ages before I agreed to do him this favor.

quiz.zh: 遇到困难的时候，她宁可自己扛着，也不愿意开口求人。
quiz.en: When she runs into trouble, she would rather bear it herself than ask anyone for help.

转.gloss: to turn; to revolve; to rotate

example.zh: 地球一边自转，一边绕着太阳转。
example.en: The Earth spins on its axis while revolving around the sun.

quiz.zh: 风扇坏了，打开开关以后一点儿也不转。
quiz.en: The fan is broken; when you switch it on it doesn't turn at all.

线.gloss: thread; line, wire; measure word for routes and lines
线.indonesian: benang; garis, kabel; kata penggolong untuk jalur

example.zh: 妈妈拿出针和线，帮我把掉了的扣子缝上了。
example.en: Mom took out a needle and thread and sewed my lost button back on.

quiz.zh: 坐地铁二号线到终点站，再走五分钟就到了。
quiz.en: Take Metro Line 2 to the last stop, then walk five more minutes and you're there.

example.zh: 这场比赛因下大雨被迫推迟到下周。
example.en: The match was forced to be postponed until next week because of heavy rain.

quiz.zh: 他因工作出色，被公司评为年度优秀员工。
quiz.en: Because of his outstanding work, he was named the company's employee of the year.

example.zh: 这家店的面条特好吃，每天中午都要排队。
example.en: The noodles at this shop are especially good; there's a queue every lunchtime.

quiz.zh: 他这个人特爱面子，从来不肯当众认错。
quiz.en: He cares an awful lot about face and never admits he's wrong in public.

局.gloss: measure word for games or sets; bureau, office; situation
局.indonesian: kata penggolong untuk babak/set permainan; biro, kantor; situasi

example.zh: 我们下了三局棋，他赢了两局。
example.en: We played three games of chess, and he won two.

quiz.zh: 他在市公安局工作了二十多年，快要退休了。
quiz.en: He has worked at the city public security bureau for over twenty years and is about to retire.

example.zh: 这个问题至今未得到解决，居民们很着急。
example.en: This problem has not been solved to this day, and residents are very anxious.

quiz.zh: 该病毒的来源目前尚未查明，专家仍在调查中。
quiz.en: The source of the virus has not yet been identified, and experts are still investigating.

example.zh: 古希腊人相信，天上的雷电是由神控制的。
example.en: The ancient Greeks believed that thunder and lightning were controlled by the gods.

quiz.zh: 这个魔术太神了，大家都猜不出他是怎么做到的。
quiz.en: That magic trick was amazing; nobody could figure out how he did it.

清.gloss: clear; to clear up, to settle (fully)

example.zh: 这条小河的水很清，能看见河底的石头。
example.en: The water in this stream is so clear you can see the stones on the bottom.

quiz.zh: 他花了整整五年，才把欠银行的钱还清。
quiz.en: It took him five full years to pay off what he owed the bank.

轮.gloss: wheel; to take turns; measure word for rounds
轮.indonesian: roda; bergiliran; kata penggolong untuk babak/putaran

example.zh: 下一轮比赛将在明天下午举行。
example.en: The next round of the competition will be held tomorrow afternoon.

quiz.zh: 排队排了一个多小时，终于轮到我了。
quiz.en: After queuing for over an hour, it was finally my turn.

逼.gloss: to force; to compel; to press

example.zh: 父母不应该逼孩子去学他们不喜欢的东西。
example.en: Parents shouldn't force children to learn things they don't like.

quiz.zh: 要不是被生活所逼，他也不会一个人跑到外地打工。
quiz.en: If life hadn't forced him, he wouldn't have gone off alone to work in another city.

待.gloss: to stay; to remain (somewhere for a while)

example.zh: 放假的时候我哪儿也没去，一直在家里待着。
example.en: During the holiday I didn't go anywhere; I just stayed at home.

quiz.zh: 这次出差我在上海只待了两天，没时间去玩儿。
quiz.en: On this business trip I only stayed in Shanghai for two days and had no time for sightseeing.

尽.gloss: to use up, to exhaust; to the utmost, to do one's best

example.zh: 医生已经尽了最大的努力，可还是没能救回他。
example.en: The doctors did their very best, but still couldn't save him.

quiz.zh: 这件事我会尽力去办，但不能保证一定成功。
quiz.en: I'll do my best with this, but I can't guarantee it will succeed.

盘.gloss: measure word for plates of food, games and coils; to coil, to wind
盘.indonesian: kata penggolong untuk piring makanan, permainan, gulungan; melingkar

example.zh: 服务员端上来一盘红烧鱼，香味一下子飘满了屋子。
example.en: The waiter brought out a plate of braised fish, and the aroma instantly filled the room.

quiz.zh: 爷爷吃完晚饭，总要拉着邻居下两盘象棋。
quiz.en: After dinner, Grandpa always drags the neighbor into a couple of games of Chinese chess.

皮.gloss: skin; leather; peel; naughty (of a child)
皮.indonesian: kulit; kulit binatang, kulit buah; nakal (anak-anak)

example.zh: 苹果皮里含有很多营养，洗干净了可以直接吃。
example.en: Apple peel is full of nutrients; once washed, it can be eaten as it is.

quiz.zh: 这件皮夹克质量很好，穿了五六年还跟新的一样。
quiz.en: This leather jacket is great quality; after five or six years it still looks new.

落.gloss: to leave behind (by mistake); to forget to bring; to fall behind

example.zh: 糟糕，我把手机落在出租车上了！
example.en: Oh no, I left my phone in the taxi!

quiz.zh: 他生病请了一个月假，功课落下了不少，得抓紧补。
quiz.en: He was off sick for a month and fell well behind in his schoolwork, so he has to hurry to catch up.

网.gloss: net; network, the internet; to catch with a net

example.zh: 渔民们一大早就出海撒网捕鱼了。
example.en: The fishermen went out to sea early in the morning to cast their nets.

quiz.zh: 酒店房间里上不了网，我只好去楼下大厅。
quiz.en: I couldn't get online in my hotel room, so I had to go down to the lobby.

招.gloss: to recruit; to attract; to beckon

example.zh: 我们公司今年打算招二十名新员工。
example.en: Our company plans to recruit twenty new employees this year.

quiz.zh: 夏天晚上开着灯不关窗户，很容易招蚊子。
quiz.en: On summer nights, if you leave the light on with the window open, you easily attract mosquitoes.

科.gloss: branch of study; field, discipline; subject
科.indonesian: bidang studi; cabang ilmu; mata pelajaran

example.zh: 他上学时文科成绩一般，理科却特别好。
example.en: At school his humanities grades were average, but he was excellent at the sciences.

quiz.zh: 这次期末考试我有一科没及格，暑假还得补考。
quiz.en: I failed one subject in the final exams, so I have to retake it over the summer.

版.gloss: edition; version; page of a newspaper

example.zh: 这本词典去年出了新版，增加了不少流行词。
example.en: This dictionary came out in a new edition last year, adding quite a few popular words.

quiz.zh: 这条新闻登在今天报纸的第一版上。
quiz.en: This news story is on the front page of today's paper.

example.zh: 他出生在南方的一个小镇，那里到处都是小河和石桥。
example.en: He was born in a small town in the south, full of streams and stone bridges.

quiz.zh: 从县城坐车到镇上要一个多小时。
quiz.en: It takes over an hour by bus from the county seat to the town.

example.zh: 面试一开始，经理请每个人先做个简单的自我介绍。
example.en: At the start of the interview, the manager asked each person to briefly introduce themselves.

quiz.zh: 年轻人应该多出去走走，在不同的经历中认识自我。
quiz.en: Young people should get out more and discover themselves through different experiences.

犯.gloss: to commit (a crime or mistake); to violate

example.zh: 谁都会犯错误，重要的是能从中吸取教训。
example.en: Everyone makes mistakes; what matters is learning from them.

quiz.zh: 酒后开车是犯法的，千万不要抱侥幸心理。
quiz.en: Drink-driving is against the law; never think you'll get away with it.

服.gloss: to obey; to be convinced, to accept (someone's superiority); to serve

example.zh: 他这次输得心服口服，下了台还主动跟对手握手。
example.en: This time he lost fair and square and accepted it, even shaking his opponent's hand after leaving the stage.

quiz.zh: 你说得这么有道理，我不得不服你。
quiz.en: What you said makes so much sense that I have to hand it to you.

样.gloss: measure word for kinds, types or items

example.zh: 妈妈今天做了好几样菜，都是我爱吃的。
example.en: Mom made several kinds of dishes today, all ones I love.

quiz.zh: 这次去超市只买了三样东西，却花了两百多块。
quiz.en: I only bought three things at the supermarket this time, yet spent over two hundred yuan.

理.gloss: reason, logic; to manage, to put in order; to pay attention to

example.zh: 你说得有理，我们就按你的办法试试吧。
example.en: You have a point; let's try it your way.

quiz.zh: 我叫了他好几声，他都不理我，可能还在生气吧。
quiz.en: I called him several times but he ignored me; he's probably still angry.

射.gloss: to shoot; to fire; to emit (light)

example.zh: 他抬起脚用力一射，球直接飞进了球门。
example.en: He swung his foot and shot hard, sending the ball straight into the goal.

quiz.zh: 他拉开弓，一箭射向远处的目标。
quiz.en: He drew the bow and shot an arrow at the distant target.

example.zh: 秋天到了，路边的树叶一片片变黄了。
example.en: Autumn has come, and the leaves by the road are turning yellow one by one.

quiz.zh: 开车遇到黄灯时，最好慢慢停下来，别抢着过去。
quiz.en: When you meet a yellow light while driving, it's best to slow to a stop rather than rush through.

example.zh: 这个小岛四面都是海，只能坐船过去。
example.en: This little island is surrounded by sea and can only be reached by boat.

quiz.zh: 台风来临前，岛上的游客都被安排离开了。
quiz.en: Before the typhoon arrived, all the tourists on the island were evacuated.

混.gloss: to mix, to blend; to muddle along, to drift through (life)

example.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋混在一起，再加一点儿牛奶。
example.en: Mix the flour and eggs together, then add a little milk.

quiz.zh: 他上班从来不认真，每天就是混日子。
quiz.en: He never takes his job seriously and just drifts through each day.

编.gloss: to weave, to braid; to edit, to compile; to make up (a story)

example.zh: 奶奶用竹子编了一个篮子，又结实又好看。
example.en: Grandma wove a basket out of bamboo; it's sturdy and pretty.

quiz.zh: 你别再编故事骗我了，我已经知道真相了。
quiz.en: Stop making up stories to fool me; I already know the truth.

example.zh: 他是中国物理学会的会员，经常参加学术会议。
example.en: He is a member of the Chinese Physical Society and often attends academic conferences.

quiz.zh: 这次国际研讨会由本市的心理学会主办。
quiz.en: This international symposium is hosted by the city's psychological society.

example.zh: 洪水发生后，当地部队连夜赶去救人。
example.en: After the flood, local troops rushed through the night to rescue people.

quiz.zh: 他十八岁就到部队当兵，一干就是二十年。
quiz.en: He joined the army at eighteen and served for twenty years.

可怜.gloss: pitiful, poor; to pity, to feel sorry for

example.zh: 那只小狗又冷又饿，看起来可怜极了。
example.en: The puppy was cold and hungry and looked utterly pitiful.

quiz.zh: 我不需要别人可怜我，我只想要一个公平的机会。
quiz.en: I don't need anyone's pity; I just want a fair chance.

example.zh: 他为何突然辞职，至今没有人知道。
example.en: To this day nobody knows why he suddenly resigned.

quiz.zh: 记者问这位官员：“房价为何一涨再涨？”
quiz.en: The reporter asked the official: Why do housing prices keep rising?

爆.gloss: to explode; to burst; to break out

example.zh: 气球吹得太大，“砰”的一声爆了。
example.en: The balloon was blown up too big and burst with a bang.

quiz.zh: 车子开到一半，前面的轮胎突然爆了。
quiz.en: Halfway through the drive, the front tire suddenly blew out.

example.zh: 山上的这种蘑菇颜色很鲜艳，可是有毒，千万不能吃。
example.en: This mushroom on the mountain is brightly colored, but it's poisonous; you must never eat it.

quiz.zh: 山里有些蛇有剧毒，被咬了要马上去医院。
quiz.en: Some snakes in the mountains are highly venomous; if bitten, go to hospital immediately.

解.gloss: to untie, to undo; to solve; to relieve

example.zh: 进门以后，他弯下腰解开鞋带，把鞋脱了下来。
example.en: After coming in, he bent down, untied his laces and took off his shoes.

quiz.zh: 这道数学题我想了一晚上，还是解不出来。
quiz.en: I thought about this math problem all evening and still couldn't solve it.

example.zh: 他对自己犯下的罪感到非常后悔。
example.en: He deeply regrets the crimes he committed.

quiz.zh: 法院最后判定他无罪，当庭释放。
quiz.en: The court finally found him not guilty and released him on the spot.

启动.gloss: to start (a machine or engine); to launch (a project)

example.zh: 天气太冷，汽车打了好几次火都启动不了。
example.en: It was so cold that the car wouldn't start despite several tries.

quiz.zh: 这个城市的新地铁项目将于明年正式启动。
quiz.en: The city's new metro project will officially launch next year.

一一.gloss: one by one; one after another

example.zh: 老师把试卷上的错误一一指了出来。
example.en: The teacher pointed out the mistakes on the exam paper one by one.

quiz.zh: 会议结束后，他和到场的客人一一握手告别。
quiz.en: After the meeting, he shook hands and said goodbye to each of the guests in turn.

算是.gloss: can be considered as; more or less; at last

example.zh: 这次考试我考了八十分，算是不错了。
example.en: I got 80 on this exam, which counts as pretty good.

quiz.zh: 在这个城市住了十年，我也算是半个本地人了。
quiz.en: After living in this city for ten years, I can more or less call myself half a local.

印.gloss: seal, stamp; mark, print; to print

example.zh: 请把这份材料印二十份，下午开会要用。
example.en: Please print twenty copies of this document; we need them for the meeting this afternoon.

quiz.zh: 雪地上留下了一串小动物的脚印。
quiz.en: A trail of small animal footprints was left in the snow.

透.gloss: to pass through, to penetrate; thorough(ly), completely

example.zh: 外面雨下得很大，我的衣服全都湿透了。
example.en: It was pouring outside, and my clothes got soaked through.

quiz.zh: 阳光透过窗帘照进房间，屋里一下子亮了。
quiz.en: Sunlight came through the curtains, and the room suddenly brightened.

example.zh: 他戴着墨镜骑着摩托车，看起来特别酷。
example.en: Wearing sunglasses and riding a motorbike, he looked really cool.

quiz.zh: 哇，你这双新球鞋真酷，在哪儿买的？
quiz.en: Wow, your new sneakers are so cool, where did you buy them?

拖.gloss: to drag, to pull; to delay, to put off; to mop

example.zh: 他拖着一个大箱子，慢慢走出了火车站。
example.en: He dragged a big suitcase and slowly walked out of the train station.

quiz.zh: 这件事已经拖了半年了，不能再等下去了。
quiz.en: This matter has been put off for half a year already; we can't wait any longer.

example.zh: 到目前为止，已经有三百多人报名参加比赛。
example.en: So far, more than three hundred people have signed up for the competition.

quiz.zh: 盐要慢慢加，一直加到你觉得味道合适为止。
quiz.en: Add the salt slowly, until it tastes right to you.

塞.gloss: to stuff, to squeeze in; stopper, cork

example.zh: 他把几件衣服塞进背包，急急忙忙出了门。
example.en: He stuffed a few clothes into his backpack and hurried out the door.

quiz.zh: 临走时，妈妈又往我手里塞了两百块钱。
quiz.en: Just as I was leaving, Mom pressed another two hundred yuan into my hand.

检测.gloss: to test; to examine; to inspect

example.zh: 这批牛奶经过检测，各项指标都符合国家标准。
example.en: This batch of milk has been tested, and every indicator meets national standards.

quiz.zh: 新房装修完以后，最好请专业人员来检测一下空气质量。
quiz.en: After renovating a new home, it's best to have professionals test the air quality.

制.gloss: to make, to manufacture; to formulate (rules)

example.zh: 这种药是用天然植物制成的，副作用很小。
example.en: This medicine is made from natural plants and has few side effects.

quiz.zh: 这家工厂专门制药，产品主要出口欧洲。
quiz.en: This factory specializes in making medicines, mostly exported to Europe.

泡.gloss: bubble; blister; to soak; to steep (tea)

example.zh: 客人来了，爸爸赶紧泡了一壶茶。
example.en: When the guests arrived, Dad quickly made a pot of tea.

quiz.zh: 走了一天路，晚上用热水泡脚特别舒服。
quiz.en: After walking all day, soaking your feet in hot water in the evening feels wonderful.

户.gloss: measure word for households or families

example.zh: 这栋楼一共住着三十户人家。
example.en: Thirty households live in this building altogether.

quiz.zh: 这个村子只有一百来户，大部分年轻人都去城里打工了。
quiz.en: This village has only about a hundred households; most of the young people have gone to work in the city.

归.gloss: to return; to give back; to be the responsibility of

example.zh: 借来的书看完了要及时归还图书馆。
example.en: Once you've finished borrowed books, return them to the library promptly.

quiz.zh: 家里的事你别管，做饭洗碗归我，你只管好好学习。
quiz.en: Don't worry about the housework; cooking and washing up are my job, you just focus on studying.

example.zh: 我们家的母鸡每天都下一个蛋。
example.en: Our hen lays an egg every day.

quiz.zh: 这只母猫刚生了四只小猫，正在窝里喂奶呢。
quiz.en: This mother cat just had four kittens and is nursing them in the nest.

冒.gloss: to emit, to give off; to risk, to brave

example.zh: 锅里的水已经开了，正咕嘟咕嘟地冒着热气。
example.en: The water in the pot has come to the boil and is bubbling away, giving off steam.

quiz.zh: 消防员冒着生命危险冲进了火里。
quiz.en: The firefighters risked their lives and rushed into the fire.

example.zh: 狼一般是成群活动的，很少单独出来找吃的。
example.en: Wolves usually move in packs and rarely hunt for food alone.

quiz.zh: 小时候奶奶常给我讲小羊和大灰狼的故事。
quiz.en: When I was little, Grandma often told me the story of the little lamb and the big bad wolf.

example.zh: 工人们正在路边挖坑，准备种树。
example.en: The workers are digging holes by the road to plant trees.

quiz.zh: 考古学家在这里挖出了一批两千年前的文物。
quiz.en: Archaeologists dug up a batch of 2,000-year-old relics here.

要么.gloss: either... or...; or else, how about
要么.indonesian: atau... atau...; kalau tidak, bagaimana kalau

example.zh: 周末我要么在家看书，要么去公园跑步。
example.en: On weekends I either read at home or go running in the park.

quiz.zh: 坐公交太慢了，要么我们打个车吧？
quiz.en: The bus is too slow; how about we take a taxi instead?

example.zh: 他年轻时当过三年兵，到现在还保持着早起的习惯。
example.en: He served three years as a soldier when he was young and still keeps the habit of getting up early.

quiz.zh: 古代打仗时，哪一方的兵多，哪一方就占优势。
quiz.en: In ancient warfare, whichever side had more soldiers had the advantage.

侧.gloss: side; to lean or turn to one side

example.zh: 学校大门的两侧种满了各种颜色的花。
example.en: Both sides of the school gate are full of flowers of every color.

quiz.zh: 车厢里人太多，我只能侧着身子挤过去。
quiz.en: The carriage was so crowded that I had to squeeze through sideways.

example.zh: 他闭上眼睛，深深地吸了一口气。
example.en: He closed his eyes and took a deep breath.

quiz.zh: 这家博物馆每周一闭馆，参观前请看好时间。
quiz.en: This museum is closed every Monday, so please check the times before visiting.

example.zh: 把面粉和水混在一起，揉成一个光滑的面团。
example.en: Mix the flour with water and knead it into a smooth dough.

quiz.zh: 小女孩穿着一条粉色的连衣裙，看起来特别可爱。
quiz.en: The little girl is wearing a pink dress and looks really cute.

足.gloss: sufficient, enough; fully, as much as; foot

example.zh: 这次旅行的钱我已经准备足了，你不用担心。
example.en: I've already saved enough money for this trip, so don't worry.

quiz.zh: 这个箱子足有五十斤重，我一个人根本搬不动。
quiz.en: This box weighs a good 25 kilos; I can't possibly move it by myself.

example.zh: 她在晚会上弹了一首钢琴曲，赢得了热烈的掌声。
example.en: She played a piano piece at the party and won warm applause.

quiz.zh: 这首歌的词是他写的，曲是他妹妹谱的。
quiz.en: He wrote the lyrics of this song, and his sister composed the music.

example.zh: 这是公家的东西，不能随便拿回家用。
example.en: This is public property; you can't just take it home to use.

quiz.zh: 这些钱是公款，谁也不能私自动用。
quiz.en: This money is public funds; nobody may use it privately.

肥.gloss: fat (of animals or meat); loose-fitting; fertilizer

example.zh: 这块肉太肥了，我还是喜欢吃瘦一点儿的。
example.en: This piece of meat is too fatty; I prefer leaner cuts.

quiz.zh: 春天到了，农民们忙着给庄稼施肥。
quiz.en: Spring has arrived, and the farmers are busy fertilizing their crops.

患.gloss: to suffer from (an illness); to contract

example.zh: 他患上了严重的心脏病，需要马上做手术。
example.en: He has developed serious heart disease and needs surgery right away.

quiz.zh: 研究表明，长期睡眠不足的人更容易患抑郁症。
quiz.en: Research shows that people who are chronically short of sleep are more likely to suffer from depression.

害.gloss: harm; to harm; to cause (someone trouble)
害.indonesian: bahaya, kerugian; mencelakakan; menyebabkan (orang lain susah)

example.zh: 抽烟对身体有害，你还是早点戒了吧。
example.en: Smoking is harmful to your health; you'd better quit soon.

quiz.zh: 都怪你没提醒我，害我白跑了一趟。
quiz.en: It's your fault for not reminding me; you made me go all that way for nothing.

立.gloss: to stand; to set up, to erect; to establish

example.zh: 广场中央立着一座英雄纪念碑。
example.en: A monument to heroes stands in the middle of the square.

quiz.zh: 他在战场上立过大功，回国后受到了表彰。
quiz.en: He performed great deeds on the battlefield and was honored when he returned home.

example.zh: 这件衣服的料很好，摸起来又软又舒服。
example.en: The fabric of this garment is very good; it feels soft and comfortable.

quiz.zh: 谁也没料到，这场比赛最后竟然是他们赢了。
quiz.en: Nobody expected that they would end up winning the match.

example.zh: 这座博物馆从下个月起免费向公众开放。
example.en: This museum will be open to the public free of charge from next month.

quiz.zh: 作为公众人物，他的一言一行都会受到大家关注。
quiz.en: As a public figure, his every word and deed attracts attention.

撒.gloss: to sprinkle; to scatter; to spill

example.zh: 汤快好的时候，再撒上一点儿葱花。
example.en: When the soup is almost ready, sprinkle on some chopped scallions.

quiz.zh: 农民把种子均匀地撒在地里。
quiz.en: The farmer scattered the seeds evenly over the field.

露.gloss: to show, to reveal; to expose; to appear

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，她脸上露出了笑容。
example.en: Hearing the good news, a smile appeared on her face.

quiz.zh: 他太紧张了，一开口就露出了马脚。
quiz.en: He was so nervous that he gave himself away the moment he opened his mouth.

为此.gloss: for this reason; to this end; therefore

example.zh: 他想去国外留学，为此每天都在努力学英语。
example.en: He wants to study abroad, and to that end he works hard at English every day.

quiz.zh: 公司今年的销量大幅下降，老板为此专门开了一次会。
quiz.en: The company's sales dropped sharply this year, and the boss held a special meeting about it.

环.gloss: ring, loop; link (in a chain); to surround
环.indonesian: cincin, lingkaran; mata rantai, bagian; mengelilingi

example.zh: 她耳朵上戴着一对金耳环，是妈妈送给她的生日礼物。
example.en: She is wearing a pair of gold earrings, a birthday present from her mother.

quiz.zh: 这个小镇三面环山，一面靠海，风景非常美。
quiz.en: This small town is surrounded by mountains on three sides and faces the sea on the fourth; the scenery is beautiful.

回头.gloss: to turn one's head, to look back; later, in a while

example.zh: 听到有人叫他的名字，他马上回头看了看。
example.en: Hearing someone call his name, he immediately turned around to look.

quiz.zh: 我现在有点儿忙，回头再给你打电话。
quiz.en: I'm a bit busy right now; I'll call you back later.

example.zh: 法官认真听取了双方的意见后才作出判决。
example.en: The judge listened carefully to both sides before handing down a verdict.

quiz.zh: 他从小就梦想当一名法官，维护社会公平。
quiz.en: Since childhood he has dreamed of becoming a judge and upholding social justice.

example.zh: 心脏的作用是把血液送到全身各处。
example.en: The heart's job is to pump blood to every part of the body.

quiz.zh: 适当运动可以促进血液循环，对身体有好处。
quiz.en: Moderate exercise improves blood circulation and is good for your health.

松.gloss: loose, slack; to loosen, to relax

example.zh: 我最近瘦了，以前的裤子都变松了。
example.en: I've lost weight recently, and my old trousers have all become loose.

quiz.zh: 考试终于结束了，大家都松了一口气。
quiz.en: The exams are finally over, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

example.zh: 小狗把骨头埋在了院子里的树下。
example.en: The puppy buried its bone under the tree in the yard.

quiz.zh: 地震发生时，有十几个人被埋在了倒塌的房子下面。
quiz.en: When the earthquake struck, more than ten people were buried under collapsed houses.

率.gloss: rate; proportion (as a suffix, e.g. success rate)

example.zh: 这家医院的手术成功率达到了百分之九十八。
example.en: This hospital's surgical success rate has reached 98%.

quiz.zh: 今年大学生的就业率比去年略有提高。
quiz.en: This year's employment rate for university graduates is slightly higher than last year's.

example.zh: 山上有很多野花，红的、黄的、白的都有。
example.en: There are lots of wildflowers on the mountain, red, yellow and white.

quiz.zh: 山里经常有野猪跑出来，把庄稼都吃光了。
quiz.en: Wild boars often come out of the mountains and eat up all the crops.

example.zh: 活了三十多年，我从未见过这么美的风景。
example.en: In over thirty years of life, I have never seen such beautiful scenery.

quiz.zh: 他在这家公司工作了十年，从未迟到过一次。
quiz.en: He has worked at this company for ten years and has never once been late.

业.gloss: industry, trade (as a suffix, e.g. tourism industry); occupation

example.zh: 这个海边小城主要靠旅游业发展经济。
example.en: This small seaside city relies mainly on tourism for its economy.

quiz.zh: 近几年，网上购物的兴起带动了快递业的发展。
quiz.en: In recent years, the rise of online shopping has driven the growth of the courier industry.

补.gloss: to make up for; to supplement; to mend, to patch

example.zh: 上周我病了没上课，这周得把落下的课补回来。
example.en: I was sick and missed class last week, so this week I have to make up the lessons I missed.

quiz.zh: 我的袜子破了个洞，奶奶帮我补好了。
quiz.en: My sock had a hole in it, and Grandma mended it for me.

example.zh: 专家提醒，如果身边的人流露出自杀的念头，一定要及时寻求帮助。
example.en: Experts advise that if someone close to you shows suicidal thoughts, you must seek help promptly.

quiz.zh: 小说的结尾，主人公因为绝望而选择了自杀。
quiz.en: At the end of the novel, the protagonist takes his own life out of despair.

引.gloss: to lead, to guide; to attract; to cause

example.zh: 服务员把我们引到了靠窗的座位。
example.en: The waiter led us to a table by the window.

quiz.zh: 这件红色的裙子在人群中特别引人注目。
quiz.en: This red dress really catches the eye in a crowd.

闪.gloss: to flash; to sparkle; to dodge

example.zh: 天上闪了一道光，紧接着就是一声响雷。
example.en: A flash of light lit up the sky, followed immediately by a clap of thunder.

quiz.zh: 一辆车冲了过来，他赶紧往旁边一闪，才没被撞到。
quiz.en: A car came rushing at him; he quickly dodged aside and just avoided being hit.

散.gloss: to scatter; to disperse; to break up

example.zh: 电影散场以后，人们一下子涌到了街上。
example.en: When the movie let out, people poured into the street all at once.

quiz.zh: 风一吹，天上的乌云很快就散了。
quiz.en: As soon as the wind blew, the dark clouds quickly dispersed.

example.zh: 就算明天下雨，比赛也会照常进行。
example.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, the match will go ahead as usual.

quiz.zh: 这件事就算你不说，我早晚也会知道的。
quiz.en: Even if you don't tell me, I'll find out sooner or later.

example.zh: 奶奶眼睛不好，穿针的时候总要叫我帮忙。
example.en: Grandma's eyesight is poor, so she always asks me to help thread the needle.

quiz.zh: 小孩子一听要打针，就吓得哭了起来。
quiz.en: As soon as the child heard he needed a shot, he burst into tears in fright.

example.zh: 这位官员因为收受贿赂被调查了。
example.en: This official is under investigation for taking bribes.

quiz.zh: 两国政府官员昨天在北京举行了会谈。
quiz.en: Government officials from the two countries held talks in Beijing yesterday.

example.zh: 这孩子脑子很灵，什么东西一学就会。
example.en: This kid is really quick-witted and picks up anything right away.

quiz.zh: 我这脑子真不好使，刚说过的话转眼就忘了。
quiz.en: My brain really isn't working well; I forget what I've just said in the blink of an eye.

肯.gloss: to be willing to; to agree to

example.zh: 我劝了他半天，他就是不肯去医院。
example.en: I tried to persuade him for ages, but he simply wouldn't go to the hospital.

quiz.zh: 只要你肯努力，就一定能把成绩提上去。
quiz.en: As long as you're willing to work hard, you'll definitely raise your grades.

example.zh: 我原本打算周末去爬山，结果下雨了。
example.en: I originally planned to go hiking at the weekend, but then it rained.

quiz.zh: 这里原本是一片荒地，现在已经建成了一个大公园。
quiz.en: This was originally wasteland; now it has become a big park.

example.zh: 故宫是明清两代的皇宫，每年吸引大量游客。
example.en: The Forbidden City was the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties and attracts huge numbers of tourists every year.

quiz.zh: 古时候，皇帝和他的家人都住在宫里。
quiz.en: In ancient times, the emperor and his family all lived in the palace.

望.gloss: to gaze into the distance, to look at; to hope

example.zh: 站在山顶向远处望去，整个城市都在眼前。
example.en: Looking out into the distance from the mountaintop, the whole city lies before you.

quiz.zh: 他站在船头，望着越来越远的海岸，心里很不是滋味。
quiz.en: Standing at the bow, he gazed at the shore growing more and more distant, feeling miserable.

example.zh: 地铁站里有专门为残疾人设计的无障碍通道。
example.en: The metro station has barrier-free passageways specially designed for disabled people.

quiz.zh: 请不要把车停在消防通道上，以免影响救援。
quiz.en: Please don't park in the fire lane, so as not to obstruct rescue work.

example.zh: 每年春天，农民们都要下田插秧。
example.en: Every spring, farmers go into the fields to transplant rice seedlings.

quiz.zh: 村子周围都是绿油油的稻田，风景特别好。
quiz.en: The village is surrounded by lush green rice paddies; the scenery is lovely.

example.zh: 他在音乐方面很有才能，十岁就开始作曲了。
example.en: He is very talented in music and started composing at the age of ten.

quiz.zh: 这次比赛给了年轻人一个展示才能的机会。
quiz.en: This competition gave young people an opportunity to show their talents.

example.zh: 这个广告很有创意，看过的人都记住了。
example.en: This ad is very creative; everyone who saw it remembered it.

quiz.zh: 设计比赛中，评委最看重的是作品的创意。
quiz.en: In the design competition, what the judges value most is the originality of the work.

example.zh: 突然停电了，整个房间顿时陷入一片黑暗。
example.en: The power suddenly went out, and the whole room was instantly plunged into darkness.

quiz.zh: 他在黑暗中摸索了半天，才找到电灯开关。
quiz.en: He groped around in the dark for a long time before finding the light switch.

大师.gloss: master; great expert (in an art or skill)

example.zh: 他是世界有名的建筑大师，设计过很多著名建筑。
example.en: He is a world-renowned master architect who has designed many famous buildings.

quiz.zh: 这幅画出自一位国画大师之手，价值上千万元。
quiz.en: This painting is by a master of traditional Chinese painting and is worth over ten million yuan.

得知.gloss: to learn of; to hear about; to find out

example.zh: 得知自己考上了大学，他高兴得一晚上没睡着。
example.en: On learning he had got into university, he was so happy that he didn't sleep all night.

quiz.zh: 记者从有关部门得知，这条地铁线明年将正式通车。
quiz.en: Reporters have learned from the relevant authorities that this metro line will officially open next year.

之所以.gloss: the reason why (used with 'because' in the next clause)

example.zh: 他之所以成功，是因为他从来不放弃。
example.en: The reason he succeeded is that he never gives up.

quiz.zh: 我之所以选择这份工作，主要是因为离家近。
quiz.en: The main reason I chose this job is that it's close to home.

example.zh: 这本小说一共有三十章，我已经看完一半了。
example.en: This novel has thirty chapters in total, and I've already read half of them.

quiz.zh: 老师让我们下课以后预习课本的第五章。
quiz.en: The teacher told us to preview chapter five of the textbook after class.

example.zh: 这件毛衣是纯羊毛的，穿起来特别暖和。
example.en: This sweater is pure wool and very warm to wear.

quiz.zh: 我那么说纯属开玩笑，你别当真。
quiz.en: I said that purely as a joke; don't take it seriously.

定位.gloss: to locate, to pinpoint; to position; positioning

example.zh: 打开手机地图，它就能自动定位你现在的位置。
example.en: Open the map on your phone and it will automatically locate where you are.

quiz.zh: 这款汽车的市场定位是年轻的上班族。
quiz.en: This car is positioned in the market for young office workers.

一阵.gloss: a burst of; a fit of; a spell, a while

example.zh: 他话还没说完，教室里就响起了一阵笑声。
example.en: Before he had finished speaking, a burst of laughter broke out in the classroom.

quiz.zh: 一阵大风吹过，树上的叶子纷纷落了下来。
quiz.en: A gust of wind blew past, and leaves came falling down from the trees.

撑.gloss: to prop up, to support; to hold up (an umbrella); to hold out

example.zh: 外面下雨了，她撑着一把伞走了出去。
example.en: It was raining outside, and she went out holding an umbrella.

quiz.zh: 他病得很重，可为了家人还是咬牙撑着。
quiz.en: He was seriously ill, but for his family's sake he gritted his teeth and held on.

遭到.gloss: to suffer; to meet with (something bad)

example.zh: 这个计划遭到了大多数人的反对。
example.en: This plan met with opposition from most people.

quiz.zh: 这座古城在战争中遭到严重破坏，后来又重新修建了。
quiz.en: This ancient city was badly damaged in the war and was later rebuilt.

喷.gloss: to spray; to spurt; to gush

example.zh: 消防员拿着水枪，对着大火不停地喷水。
example.en: The firefighters held their hoses and kept spraying water at the blaze.

quiz.zh: 他出门前往身上喷了点儿香水。
quiz.en: He sprayed on a little cologne before going out.

example.zh: 保护市民的安全是警察的职责。
example.en: Protecting citizens' safety is the duty of the police.

quiz.zh: 新来的员工要先了解自己的岗位职责。
quiz.en: New employees should first understand the responsibilities of their position.

改造.gloss: to transform; to rebuild; to remodel

example.zh: 这片老房子经过改造，变成了一个热闹的文化街区。
example.en: After being renovated, these old houses became a lively cultural district.

quiz.zh: 他把自家的车库改造成了一间小小的工作室。
quiz.en: He converted his garage into a small studio.

引发.gloss: to trigger; to cause; to set off

example.zh: 一个小小的烟头就可能引发一场森林大火。
example.en: A single cigarette butt can set off a forest fire.

quiz.zh: 这项新政策一出台，就在网上引发了激烈的讨论。
quiz.en: As soon as the new policy was announced, it sparked heated debate online.

example.zh: 这条山路又窄又陡，开车走很险。
example.en: This mountain road is narrow and steep, and driving on it is dangerous.

quiz.zh: 刚才那辆车开得太快，险些撞到路边的小孩。
quiz.en: That car was going too fast just now and nearly hit a child at the roadside.

夺.gloss: to seize, to snatch; to win (a title or prize)

example.zh: 一个小偷从她手里夺过包，转身就跑了。
example.en: A thief snatched the bag from her hand and ran off.

quiz.zh: 中国女排在决赛中战胜对手，夺得了冠军。
quiz.en: The Chinese women's volleyball team beat their opponents in the final and won the championship.

example.zh: 因为天气原因，这几天市场上的蔬菜供应不足。
example.en: Because of the weather, vegetables have been in short supply at the market these past few days.

quiz.zh: 这家工厂长期为几家大超市供应新鲜牛奶。
quiz.en: This factory has long supplied fresh milk to several large supermarkets.

一时.gloss: for a while, temporarily; for a moment, momentarily

example.zh: 他的名字我一时想不起来了。
example.en: I can't recall his name at the moment.

quiz.zh: 他只是一时冲动才说了那些话，你别往心里去。
quiz.en: He only said those things on a momentary impulse; don't take it to heart.

抛.gloss: to throw, to toss; to abandon

example.zh: 新娘转过身，把手里的花抛向身后的客人。
example.en: The bride turned around and tossed her bouquet to the guests behind her.

quiz.zh: 他为了事业，竟然抛下妻子和孩子去了国外。
quiz.en: For the sake of his career, he actually abandoned his wife and children and went abroad.

显.gloss: obvious, noticeable; to show, to appear, to look

example.zh: 这件黑色的衣服穿在你身上显得很瘦。
example.en: This black outfit makes you look slim.

quiz.zh: 她一点儿也不显老，五十多岁看起来像三十多。
quiz.en: She doesn't look old at all; in her fifties she looks like she's in her thirties.

战胜.gloss: to defeat; to overcome; to triumph over

example.zh: 经过一年的治疗，他终于战胜了病魔。
example.en: After a year of treatment, he finally beat his illness.

quiz.zh: 在昨晚的比赛中，主队以三比一战胜了客队。
quiz.en: In last night's match, the home team beat the visitors three to one.

example.zh: 这片树林很密，阳光几乎照不进来。
example.en: This forest is so dense that sunlight can hardly get through.

quiz.zh: 菜苗种得太密了，得拔掉一些才能长好。
quiz.en: The seedlings were planted too densely; some need to be pulled out for the rest to grow well.

播.gloss: to broadcast; to air; to sow

example.zh: 这场比赛电视台将进行现场直播。
example.en: The TV station will broadcast this match live.

quiz.zh: 这个节目每周六晚上八点播出，很受观众欢迎。
quiz.en: This program airs at 8 p.m. every Saturday and is very popular with viewers.

社.gloss: society, association, club; agency (e.g. travel agency)
社.indonesian: perkumpulan, klub; biro, kantor (misalnya biro perjalanan)

example.zh: 他大学时参加了学校的摄影社，拍了很多好照片。
example.en: In university he joined the photography club and took lots of great photos.

quiz.zh: 这次旅行是通过一家旅行社安排的，价格比较合理。
quiz.en: This trip was arranged through a travel agency, and the price was quite reasonable.

当天.gloss: that very day; the same day
当天.indonesian: hari itu juga; pada hari yang sama

example.zh: 在网上下单的话，当天就能收到货。
example.en: If you order online, you can receive your goods the same day.

quiz.zh: 他刚到北京，当天下午就去了天安门。
quiz.en: He had only just arrived in Beijing and went to Tiananmen that very afternoon.

粘.gloss: to stick; to glue; to paste

example.zh: 他用胶水把撕破的地图粘好了。
example.en: He glued the torn map back together.

quiz.zh: 下雨天走在土路上，鞋底粘满了泥。
quiz.en: Walking on a dirt road on a rainy day, the soles of my shoes got caked with mud.

钻.gloss: to drill, to bore; to get into, to burrow into

example.zh: 工人在墙上钻了几个小洞，准备挂画。
example.en: The worker drilled a few small holes in the wall to hang pictures.

quiz.zh: 天太冷了，小猫一下子钻进了我的被子里。
quiz.en: It was so cold that the kitten slipped straight under my quilt.

example.zh: 《罗密欧与朱丽叶》是莎士比亚最有名的悲剧之一。
example.en: Romeo and Juliet is one of Shakespeare's most famous tragedies.

quiz.zh: 如果司机当时没有喝酒，这场悲剧本来是可以避免的。
quiz.en: If the driver hadn't been drinking, this tragedy could have been avoided.

夹.gloss: to pick up (with chopsticks or tongs); to press from both sides; to squeeze

example.zh: 吃饭时，奶奶用筷子给我夹了一大块鱼。
example.en: At dinner, Grandma picked up a big piece of fish for me with her chopsticks.

quiz.zh: 下车时没注意，我的手被车门夹了一下。
quiz.en: I wasn't paying attention getting out of the car, and my hand got caught in the door.

出于.gloss: out of; due to; stemming from

example.zh: 他这么做完全是出于好心，你别误会。
example.en: He did it purely out of kindness; don't misunderstand him.

quiz.zh: 出于安全考虑，学校决定取消这次户外活动。
quiz.en: For safety reasons, the school decided to cancel the outdoor activity.

example.zh: 暴风雪过后，部分地区的电力供应暂时中断。
example.en: After the blizzard, the power supply in some areas was temporarily cut off.

quiz.zh: 这座新建的水电站可以为周边城市提供充足的电力。
quiz.en: The newly built hydroelectric station can supply ample electricity to nearby cities.

得了.gloss: to be done, to be ready; (after a verb) can manage to; that's enough
得了.indonesian: selesai, siap; (setelah kata kerja) sanggup, bisa; sudah cukup

example.zh: 饭马上就得了，你先洗手准备吃饭吧。
example.en: Dinner's almost ready; go wash your hands first.

quiz.zh: 这么重的箱子，你一个人搬得了吗？
quiz.en: Can you manage to carry such a heavy box by yourself?

example.zh: 听到奶奶去世的消息，他悲伤得说不出话来。
example.en: On hearing that his grandmother had died, he was too grief-stricken to speak.

quiz.zh: 这首曲子的旋律很悲伤，让人听了忍不住想哭。
quiz.en: The melody of this piece is so sad that it makes you want to cry.

属.gloss: to belong to; to be born in the year of (a zodiac animal)

example.zh: 这片森林属国家所有，任何人不得随意砍伐。
example.en: This forest belongs to the state, and nobody may cut it down at will.

quiz.zh: 我和我爸都属马，正好相差二十四岁。
quiz.en: My dad and I were both born in the Year of the Horse, exactly twenty-four years apart.

损伤.gloss: to damage, to harm, to injure; damage, injury

example.zh: 长时间戴耳机听音乐，会损伤听力。
example.en: Listening to music through headphones for long periods can damage your hearing.

quiz.zh: 这次摔倒让他的膝盖受到了严重损伤，三个月不能跑步。
quiz.en: The fall badly injured his knee, and he can't run for three months.

example.zh: 这部电影的主角是一个普通的出租车司机。
example.en: The protagonist of this film is an ordinary taxi driver.

quiz.zh: 她第一次演主角，演出前紧张得一晚上没睡好。
quiz.en: It was her first time playing the lead, and she was so nervous before the show that she barely slept.

example.zh: 她脸上总是带着甜甜的笑容。
example.en: She always has a sweet smile on her face.

quiz.zh: 听说儿子考上了大学，妈妈的脸上露出了久违的笑容。
quiz.en: Hearing that her son had got into university, a long-absent smile appeared on the mother's face.

example.zh: 遇到困难时，要学会向别人寻求帮助。
example.en: When you run into difficulties, learn to seek help from others.

quiz.zh: 两国领导人希望通过对话寻求解决问题的办法。
quiz.en: The leaders of the two countries hope to find a solution to the problem through dialogue.

example.zh: 她把内心的痛苦隐藏得很深，从来不让别人看出来。
example.en: She hides her inner pain deep inside and never lets others see it.

quiz.zh: 这个看起来很普通的软件里，竟然隐藏着一个病毒。
quiz.en: This ordinary-looking piece of software actually had a virus hidden inside it.

算了.gloss: forget it; never mind; let it go

example.zh: 算了，既然他不想去，我们就别勉强他了。
example.en: Forget it; since he doesn't want to go, let's not force him.

quiz.zh: 太晚了，今天就算了吧，我们明天再接着干。
quiz.en: It's too late; let's call it a day and carry on tomorrow.

狠.gloss: ruthless, fierce; to harden one's heart; severely, firmly
狠.indonesian: kejam, ganas; mengeraskan hati; dengan keras

example.zh: 他狠狠地批评了自己的儿子一顿。
example.en: He gave his son a severe scolding.

quiz.zh: 她狠下心来，把一直舍不得扔的旧东西全都处理掉了。
quiz.en: She steeled herself and got rid of all the old things she had never been able to throw away.

天下.gloss: the world; all under heaven; the whole country

example.zh: 天下没有免费的午餐，这么便宜的东西你可要小心。
example.en: There's no such thing as a free lunch; be careful with something this cheap.

quiz.zh: 古代很多皇帝都梦想着统一天下。
quiz.en: In ancient times, many emperors dreamed of unifying the whole realm.

example.zh: 别看他年纪小，下棋可是个高手。
example.en: He may be young, but he's an expert at chess.

quiz.zh: 这次比赛高手如云，能进前十就很不错了。
quiz.en: This competition is full of top players; making the top ten would be great.

example.zh: 喝了一碗热汤，身上一下子就暖了。
example.en: After a bowl of hot soup, I warmed up right away.

quiz.zh: 他把冰凉的双手放在火炉边暖了一会儿。
quiz.en: He held his icy hands by the stove for a while to warm them.

example.zh: 妈妈说，作业写完以前不许看电视。
example.en: Mom says no TV until homework is done.

quiz.zh: 图书馆里不许大声说话，也不能吃东西。
quiz.en: In the library you may not talk loudly, and eating is not allowed either.

录像.gloss: video recording; to record on video

example.zh: 婚礼那天，他用手机录像，把整个过程都录了下来。
example.en: On the wedding day, he filmed the whole thing on his phone.

quiz.zh: 警察调出了商店门口的监控录像，很快找到了小偷。
quiz.en: The police pulled the surveillance footage from outside the shop and quickly found the thief.

免.gloss: to exempt, to excuse from; to avoid

example.zh: 七十岁以上的老人乘坐公交车免票。
example.en: Seniors over seventy ride the bus for free.

quiz.zh: 客气话就免了吧，咱们都是老朋友了。
quiz.en: Let's skip the pleasantries; we're old friends.

转身.gloss: to turn around; to turn one's body

example.zh: 他转身向门口走去，再也没有回头。
example.en: He turned and walked toward the door, never looking back.

quiz.zh: 我刚想跟她打招呼，她就转身离开了。
quiz.en: I was just about to say hello, but she turned around and left.

example.zh: 国家主席昨天在北京会见了来访的外国总统。
example.en: The President yesterday met the visiting foreign president in Beijing.

quiz.zh: 总经理明天上午要会见几位重要的客户。
quiz.en: The general manager will meet several important clients tomorrow morning.

example.zh: 这次比赛的胜利，无疑给了全队很大的信心。
example.en: This victory undoubtedly gave the whole team a big confidence boost.

quiz.zh: 对一个刚毕业的学生来说，这份工作无疑是个难得的机会。
quiz.en: For a fresh graduate, this job is without doubt a rare opportunity.

救命.gloss: to save a life; Help! (cry for help)

example.zh: 他掉进了河里，一边挣扎一边拼命地喊：“救命啊！”
example.en: He fell into the river and, struggling, shouted desperately: Help!

quiz.zh: 你真是我的救命恩人，要不是你，我早就没命了。
quiz.en: You're truly the one who saved my life; if not for you, I'd be dead.

example.zh: 联合国总部设在美国纽约，每年都有很多游客去参观。
example.en: The United Nations headquarters is in New York, and many tourists visit it every year.

quiz.zh: 这位外交官曾在联合国工作了十几年。
quiz.en: This diplomat once worked at the United Nations for over ten years.

持有.gloss: to hold; to possess; to own

example.zh: 根据规定，乘客必须持有有效证件才能登机。
example.en: Under the rules, passengers must hold valid ID to board.

quiz.zh: 他持有这家公司百分之二十的股份，是第二大股东。
quiz.en: He holds twenty percent of the company's shares and is its second-largest shareholder.

灭.gloss: to go out (of a light or fire); to extinguish; to destroy

example.zh: 风太大了，蜡烛一下子就被吹灭了。
example.en: The wind was so strong that the candle was blown out instantly.

quiz.zh: 消防员花了三个小时才把大火扑灭。
quiz.en: It took the firefighters three hours to put out the blaze.

example.zh: 血管就像一条条管道，把血送到身体的每一个地方。
example.en: Blood vessels are like pipes that carry blood to every part of the body.

quiz.zh: 老年人要少吃油腻的东西，保护好心脑血管。
quiz.en: Older people should eat less greasy food to protect their heart and blood vessels.

example.zh: 如果对产品有任何问题，可以拨打我们的服务热线。
example.en: If you have any questions about the product, you can call our service hotline.

quiz.zh: 市民可以通过这条热线向政府反映问题。
quiz.en: Residents can use this hotline to report problems to the government.

关联.gloss: to be related; to be connected; connection

example.zh: 这两件事表面上看没有关联，其实关系很大。
example.en: On the surface these two things seem unrelated, but they're actually closely connected.

quiz.zh: 警方正在调查这两起案件之间是否存在关联。
quiz.en: The police are investigating whether the two cases are connected.

example.zh: 在他看来，金钱永远比不上家人的健康。
example.en: In his view, money can never compare with his family's health.

quiz.zh: 他为这个项目投入了大量的时间和金钱，最后却失败了。
quiz.en: He put a great deal of time and money into the project, but it failed in the end.

example.zh: 节日期间，街头到处都挂着红灯笼。
example.en: During the festival, red lanterns hang everywhere in the streets.

quiz.zh: 每到周末，这个广场上都有街头艺人表演。
quiz.en: Every weekend, street performers put on shows in this square.

example.zh: 这个小女孩的记忆力很惊人，看一遍就能背下来。
example.en: This little girl has an amazing memory; she can recite something after reading it once.

quiz.zh: 短短十年间，这座城市发生了惊人的变化。
quiz.en: In just ten years, this city has undergone astonishing changes.

质疑.gloss: to question; to doubt; to call into question

example.zh: 很多专家对这项研究的结果提出了质疑。
example.en: Many experts have questioned the results of this study.

quiz.zh: 有网友质疑这家餐厅使用过期食材。
quiz.en: Some netizens have questioned whether this restaurant uses expired ingredients.

example.zh: 下了一夜的雨，村里的土路上全是泥。
example.en: After a whole night of rain, the village's dirt road is nothing but mud.

quiz.zh: 孩子们在田里玩了一下午，弄得满身是泥。
quiz.en: The kids played in the fields all afternoon and got covered in mud.

民众.gloss: the public; the populace; the people

example.zh: 政府应该多听听民众的声音。
example.en: The government should listen more to the voice of the people.

quiz.zh: 新的交通规定实施以后，受到了广大民众的支持。
quiz.en: After the new traffic rules took effect, they won broad public support.

example.zh: 电影里那个雨中分别的场景让很多观众流下了眼泪。
example.en: The farewell scene in the rain brought many viewers to tears.

quiz.zh: 每当想起小时候和爷爷一起钓鱼的场景，我都觉得特别温暖。
quiz.en: Whenever I recall fishing with my grandpa as a child, I feel especially warm inside.

救援.gloss: to rescue; to come to the aid of; rescue, relief

example.zh: 地震发生后，救援人员第一时间赶到了现场。
example.en: After the earthquake, rescue workers arrived on the scene right away.

quiz.zh: 几名登山者被困在山上，当地已经派出直升机前去救援。
quiz.en: Several climbers are trapped on the mountain, and the authorities have sent a helicopter to rescue them.

败.gloss: to be defeated, to lose; to fail; to defeat

example.zh: 这支球队在决赛中以一比二败给了对手。
example.en: The team lost two to one to their opponents in the final.

quiz.zh: 他这次虽然败了，但比赛中的表现大家有目共睹。
quiz.en: Although he lost this time, everyone saw how well he played.

example.zh: 昨晚那场火灾造成了很大的经济损失。
example.en: Last night's fire caused heavy economic losses.

quiz.zh: 在家里使用电器时一定要注意安全，防止发生火灾。
quiz.en: Always use electrical appliances at home safely to prevent fires.

example.zh: 这个主意太妙了，我怎么就没想到呢？
example.en: What a brilliant idea; why didn't I think of it?

quiz.zh: 他这步棋走得真妙，一下子就扭转了局面。
quiz.en: That was a brilliant move of his; it turned the game around at a stroke.

example.zh: 他很有经济头脑，二十岁就开了自己的公司。
example.en: He has a real head for business and started his own company at twenty.

quiz.zh: 遇到突发事件时，一定要保持头脑冷静。
quiz.en: When something unexpected happens, you must keep a clear head.

倒是.gloss: actually, contrary to expectation; though, but

example.zh: 这家饭馆不大，菜的味道倒是不错。
example.en: This restaurant isn't big, but the food is actually quite good.

quiz.zh: 你说得倒是轻松，可真正做起来哪有那么容易？
quiz.en: That's easy for you to say, but actually doing it is far from easy.

example.zh: 此刻，他的心情激动得无法用语言形容。
example.en: At this moment, his excitement is beyond words.

quiz.zh: 我此刻最想做的事，就是回家好好睡一觉。
quiz.en: What I want most right now is to go home and get a good night's sleep.

尺.gloss: chi (Chinese unit of length, about a third of a metre); ruler
尺.indonesian: chi (satuan panjang Tiongkok, kira-kira sepertiga meter); penggaris

example.zh: 这条鱼足有三尺长，是我见过最大的。
example.en: This fish is a full three chi long, the biggest I've ever seen.

quiz.zh: 把你的尺子借我用一下，我要画一条直线。
quiz.en: Lend me your ruler for a moment; I need to draw a straight line.

通信.gloss: to communicate (by letter, phone, etc.); to correspond; communications
通信.indonesian: berkomunikasi (lewat surat, telepon, dll.); berkorespondensi; telekomunikasi

example.zh: 大学毕业后，我们一直保持通信，至今已有二十年。
example.en: We've kept in touch by letter since graduating from university, for twenty years now.

quiz.zh: 地震发生后，灾区的通信一度中断，外界无法联系到当地居民。
quiz.en: After the earthquake, communications in the disaster zone were cut off for a time, and the outside world couldn't reach residents.

寸.gloss: cun (Chinese unit of length, about 3.3 cm); inch
寸.indonesian: cun (satuan panjang Tiongkok, kira-kira 3,3 cm); inci

example.zh: 他买了一台五十五寸的电视，放在客厅正合适。
example.en: He bought a 55-inch TV, which fits the living room perfectly.

quiz.zh: 这张照片要冲洗成几寸的？我想把它放进相框里。
quiz.en: What size should this photo be printed at? I want to put it in a frame.

example.zh: 这家超市虽小，但是日常用品一样都不缺。
example.en: This supermarket may be small, but it has every everyday item you need.

quiz.zh: 他虽已年过七十，身体却还很硬朗。
quiz.en: Although he is over seventy, he is still very fit.

example.zh: 一辆大货车停在路边，工人们正在往下搬东西。
example.en: A big truck was parked by the road, and workers were unloading it.

quiz.zh: 这条路上禁止货车通行，只有小汽车可以走。
quiz.en: Trucks are banned from this road; only cars are allowed.

出场.gloss: to appear (on stage or in a game); to come on

example.zh: 演唱会快开始了，大家都在等歌手出场。
example.en: The concert is about to begin, and everyone is waiting for the singer to come on.

quiz.zh: 这个赛季他一共出场了三十次，打进了十五个球。
quiz.en: This season he made thirty appearances in total and scored fifteen goals.

example.zh: 那个自称是银行工作人员的人其实是个骗子。
example.en: The man who claimed to be a bank employee was actually a con man.

quiz.zh: 千万别相信陌生人的短信，现在的骗子手段越来越多。
quiz.en: Never trust texts from strangers; scammers have more and more tricks these days.

example.zh: 他是这家医院外科最有名的医生。
example.en: He is the best-known doctor in this hospital's surgical department.

quiz.zh: 她大学学的是医学，毕业后当了一名外科医生。
quiz.en: She studied medicine at university and became a surgeon after graduating.

example.zh: 他被蚊子咬了一口，第二天整只手都肿了。
example.en: He got bitten by a mosquito, and the next day his whole hand was swollen.

quiz.zh: 她昨晚哭了很久，今天早上眼睛都肿了。
quiz.en: She cried for a long time last night, and this morning her eyes were puffy.

康复.gloss: to recover; to be restored to health; rehabilitation

example.zh: 经过半年的治疗，他已经完全康复了。
example.en: After six months of treatment, he has made a full recovery.

quiz.zh: 祝你早日康复，我们都等着你回来上班呢！
quiz.en: Get well soon; we're all waiting for you to come back to work!

穿过.gloss: to go through; to pass through; to cross

example.zh: 我们穿过一条小巷，来到了一家老茶馆。
example.en: We went through a little alley and came to an old teahouse.

quiz.zh: 这条河穿过整个城市，最后流进大海。
quiz.en: This river runs through the whole city and finally flows into the sea.

example.zh: 越来越多的农村人口搬到城镇生活。
example.en: More and more rural people are moving to live in towns.

quiz.zh: 这条高速公路建成以后，沿线的城镇都得到了发展。
quiz.en: Since this expressway was built, the towns along it have all developed.

example.zh: 医生提醒他，经常喝酒对肝的伤害很大。
example.en: The doctor warned him that drinking regularly does a lot of damage to the liver.

quiz.zh: 我小时候最讨厌吃猪肝，现在倒觉得挺香的。
quiz.en: As a kid I hated eating pig liver, but now I actually find it quite tasty.

也好.gloss: it's just as well, that's fine; whether... or... (in pairs)

example.zh: 坐火车也好，坐飞机也好，只要能按时到就行。
example.en: Whether by train or by plane, it's fine as long as we get there on time.

quiz.zh: 下雨了，不出去也好，我们就在家看电影吧。
quiz.en: It's raining; it's just as well we're not going out. Let's watch a movie at home.

example.zh: 上课的时候，他偷偷地在下面玩手机。
example.en: During class, he secretly played on his phone under the desk.

quiz.zh: 为了给妈妈一个惊喜，我们偷偷准备了一个生日蛋糕。
quiz.en: To surprise Mom, we secretly prepared a birthday cake.

酱.gloss: sauce; paste; jam; to pickle in soy sauce
酱.indonesian: saus; pasta; selai; mengasinkan dengan kecap

example.zh: 早上我喜欢在面包上抹一点儿草莓酱。
example.en: In the morning I like to spread a little strawberry jam on my bread.

quiz.zh: 这道菜的味道全靠这碗秘制的酱，做法从来不外传。
quiz.en: The flavor of this dish comes entirely from this secret sauce, whose recipe is never shared.

来临.gloss: to come; to arrive; to approach

example.zh: 冬天来临之前，农民们要把粮食都收进仓库。
example.en: Before winter comes, farmers have to get all their grain into the barns.

quiz.zh: 随着春节的来临，商场里的人一天比一天多。
quiz.en: As the Spring Festival approaches, the malls get busier day by day.

浮.gloss: to float; to drift; to surface

example.zh: 几片树叶浮在水面上，慢慢地往下游漂去。
example.en: A few leaves floated on the water, drifting slowly downstream.

quiz.zh: 游泳时只要放松身体，人就能自然地浮起来。
quiz.en: When swimming, as long as you relax your body, you'll float naturally.

example.zh: 这次比赛的奖品是一台新电脑。
example.en: The prize in this competition is a new computer.

quiz.zh: 答对所有问题的观众，可以领取一份小奖品。
quiz.en: Audience members who answer every question correctly can collect a small prize.

example.zh: 这家商场三楼专门卖内衣和睡衣。
example.en: The third floor of this mall sells underwear and pajamas.

quiz.zh: 内衣最好用手洗，而且要和其他衣服分开洗。
quiz.en: Underwear is best washed by hand and separately from other clothes.

困扰.gloss: to trouble; to bother; to plague

example.zh: 失眠问题已经困扰他好几年了。
example.en: Insomnia has troubled him for several years.

quiz.zh: 交通堵塞一直是困扰大城市的一个难题。
quiz.en: Traffic congestion has long been a problem plaguing big cities.

example.zh: 他打球时不小心摔倒，手臂受了伤。
example.en: He fell while playing ball and hurt his arm.

quiz.zh: 老师让学生们把手臂伸直，跟着音乐做操。
quiz.en: The teacher had the students stretch out their arms and do exercises to the music.

聚集.gloss: to gather; to assemble; to cluster

example.zh: 广场上聚集了很多人，都在等着看烟花。
example.en: Lots of people gathered in the square, all waiting to watch the fireworks.

quiz.zh: 这一带聚集了全市大部分的高科技企业。
quiz.en: Most of the city's high-tech companies are clustered in this area.

融入.gloss: to integrate into; to blend into; to fit in

example.zh: 刚到国外的时候，我花了很长时间才融入当地的生活。
example.en: When I first went abroad, it took me a long time to fit into local life.

quiz.zh: 新同事性格开朗，很快就融入了我们这个集体。
quiz.en: The new colleague is outgoing and quickly became part of our team.

高层.gloss: senior level, top management; high-ranking; high-rise
高层.indonesian: pimpinan tingkat atas; tingkat tinggi; gedung bertingkat tinggi

example.zh: 公司高层正在开会讨论明年的发展计划。
example.en: Senior management is meeting to discuss next year's development plan.

quiz.zh: 住在高层的好处是光线好，噪音也小。
quiz.en: The advantage of living on a high floor is good light and less noise.

example.zh: 作为一名军人，保卫国家是他的责任。
example.en: As a soldier, defending the country is his duty.

quiz.zh: 他爷爷年轻时是一名军人，参加过很多次战斗。
quiz.en: His grandfather was a soldier when young and fought in many battles.

example.zh: 这台相机拍出来的图像非常清晰。
example.en: The images this camera takes are very sharp.

quiz.zh: 电视突然没有图像了，只能听到声音。
quiz.en: The TV suddenly lost its picture; we could only hear the sound.

example.zh: 按照常规，新员工要先培训一个月才能上岗。
example.en: As a rule, new employees train for a month before starting work.

quiz.zh: 体检只是常规检查，你不用太紧张。
quiz.en: The physical is just a routine check-up; there's no need to be nervous.

误.gloss: to miss (because of delay); to mistake; by mistake

example.zh: 路上堵车太厉害，我差点儿误了飞机。
example.en: The traffic was so bad I nearly missed my flight.

quiz.zh: 他把盐误当成了糖，结果这道菜咸得没法吃。
quiz.en: He mistook salt for sugar, and the dish ended up too salty to eat.

example.zh: 家里新添了一台洗衣机，妈妈轻松多了。
example.en: We've added a new washing machine at home, which makes things much easier for Mom.

quiz.zh: 你的饭不够的话，锅里还有，我再给你添一碗。
quiz.en: If you haven't had enough rice, there's more in the pot; I'll get you another bowl.

被迫.gloss: to be forced; to be compelled

example.zh: 因为天气原因，飞机被迫降落在附近的机场。
example.en: Because of the weather, the plane was forced to land at a nearby airport.

quiz.zh: 公司经营困难，他被迫离开了工作了十年的岗位。
quiz.en: With the company in trouble, he was forced to leave the job he had held for ten years.

example.zh: 请用手机扫描这个二维码，就可以付款了。
example.en: Scan this QR code with your phone and you can pay.

quiz.zh: 我把这些旧照片都扫描到电脑里保存了起来。
quiz.en: I scanned all these old photos and saved them on my computer.

example.zh: 这家公司始终坚持“顾客第一”的经营理念。
example.en: This company has always held to the business philosophy of putting customers first.

quiz.zh: 现代教育理念认为，应该让孩子多动手、多思考。
quiz.en: Modern educational thinking holds that children should be encouraged to do more hands-on work and think more.

排名.gloss: to rank; to be ranked; ranking

example.zh: 在这次比赛中，他排名第三，拿到了铜牌。
example.en: He ranked third in this competition and won the bronze medal.

quiz.zh: 这所大学在全国高校中的排名一直很靠前。
quiz.en: This university has always ranked near the top among the country's universities.

逃跑.gloss: to flee; to run away; to escape

example.zh: 小偷看见警察来了，转身就逃跑了。
example.en: When the thief saw the police coming, he turned and ran.

quiz.zh: 敌人见势不妙，纷纷丢下武器逃跑。
quiz.en: Seeing things going badly, the enemy dropped their weapons one after another and fled.

众人.gloss: everyone; the crowd; all the people present

example.zh: 他的发言赢得了众人的掌声。
example.en: His speech won applause from everyone.

quiz.zh: 她一走进会场，就吸引了众人的目光。
quiz.en: As soon as she walked into the venue, she drew everyone's eyes.

尖.gloss: sharp, pointed; tip, point; (of a voice) shrill

example.zh: 这把刀很尖，用的时候要小心。
example.en: This knife is very sharp-pointed, so be careful when using it.

quiz.zh: 她站在门口，踮着脚尖往远处看。
quiz.en: She stood at the door on tiptoe, looking into the distance.

example.zh: 古代的士兵打仗时常用弓和箭。
example.en: Soldiers in ancient times often fought with bows and arrows.

quiz.zh: 光阴似箭，转眼间我们已经毕业十年了。
quiz.en: Time flies like an arrow; in the blink of an eye, it's been ten years since we graduated.

example.zh: 最近大家都在谈论这部新上映的电影。
example.en: Everyone has been talking about this newly released film lately.

quiz.zh: 在背后谈论别人的隐私是很不礼貌的。
quiz.en: It's very rude to talk about other people's private affairs behind their backs.

扭.gloss: to twist; to turn (one's head or body); to sprain

example.zh: 听到有人喊她，她扭过头来笑了笑。
example.en: Hearing someone call her, she turned her head and smiled.

quiz.zh: 下楼梯时一脚踩空，把腰扭了，疼得直不起来。
quiz.en: I missed a step going downstairs and wrenched my back; it hurt so much I couldn't stand up straight.

转换.gloss: to convert; to transform; to switch

example.zh: 这个软件可以把文字转换成语音。
example.en: This software can convert text into speech.

quiz.zh: 毕业以后，他很快完成了从学生到职员的角色转换。
quiz.en: After graduating, he quickly made the switch from student to employee.

example.zh: 碗洗净以后，要放在架子上晾干。
example.en: Once the bowls are washed clean, put them on the rack to dry.

quiz.zh: 你别净说别人，先看看你自己做得怎么样。
quiz.en: Stop just criticizing others; look at how you're doing first.

收购.gloss: to purchase; to acquire (a company); to buy up

example.zh: 这家公司去年以五亿元收购了一家小型软件企业。
example.en: Last year this company acquired a small software firm for 500 million yuan.

quiz.zh: 每到秋天，商人们就来村里收购农民种的苹果。
quiz.en: Every autumn, traders come to the village to buy up the apples the farmers grow.

example.zh: 这座大桥在洪水中被冲毁，政府决定尽快重建。
example.en: The bridge was washed away in the flood, and the government has decided to rebuild it as soon as possible.

quiz.zh: 这座古庙在战争中被毁，二十年前才重建。
quiz.en: This old temple was destroyed in the war and was only rebuilt twenty years ago.

看好.gloss: to be optimistic about; to have high hopes for; to fancy

example.zh: 很多专家都看好这家公司的发展前景。
example.en: Many experts are optimistic about this company's prospects.

quiz.zh: 赛前没有人看好这支球队，没想到他们最后拿了冠军。
quiz.en: Before the tournament nobody rated this team, but they ended up winning the title.

example.zh: 楼里的管道坏了，水一直往外流。
example.en: A pipe in the building broke, and water kept pouring out.

quiz.zh: 天然气通过地下管道输送到千家万户。
quiz.en: Natural gas is delivered to countless homes through underground pipelines.

example.zh: 名人效应让这款产品一下子成了热门。
example.en: The celebrity effect turned this product into a hit overnight.

quiz.zh: 全球气温不断升高，与温室效应有很大关系。
quiz.en: The steady rise in global temperatures has a lot to do with the greenhouse effect.

example.zh: 他吃了不新鲜的海鲜，食物中毒住进了医院。
example.en: He ate seafood that wasn't fresh and ended up in hospital with food poisoning.

quiz.zh: 冬天在不通风的房间里烧炭取暖，很容易发生一氧化碳中毒。
quiz.en: Burning charcoal for heat in an unventilated room in winter can easily cause carbon monoxide poisoning.

抑制.gloss: to suppress; to inhibit; to restrain

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，她抑制不住内心的激动，哭了出来。
example.en: Hearing the good news, she couldn't hold back her emotion and burst into tears.

quiz.zh: 这种药可以抑制细菌的生长。
quiz.en: This drug can inhibit the growth of bacteria.

example.zh: 买东西要理性，不要一看到打折就乱买。
example.en: Be rational when shopping; don't buy things on impulse just because they're on sale.

quiz.zh: 遇到问题时，我们应该理性地分析，而不是感情用事。
quiz.en: When problems arise, we should analyze them rationally rather than act on emotion.

example.zh: 这种药每天服用三次，每次两片。
example.en: Take this medicine three times a day, two tablets each time.

quiz.zh: 孕妇在服用任何药物之前，都应该先问问医生。
quiz.en: Pregnant women should consult a doctor before taking any medication.

example.zh: 这位企业家向灾区捐赠了一百万元。
example.en: This entrepreneur donated one million yuan to the disaster area.

quiz.zh: 他去世后，家人按照他的遗愿把他的藏书捐赠给了学校。
quiz.en: After he died, his family donated his book collection to the school according to his wishes.

交谈.gloss: to chat; to converse; to talk with

example.zh: 两个人用英语交谈了半个多小时。
example.en: The two of them talked in English for over half an hour.

quiz.zh: 开车时尽量不要和乘客交谈，以免分心。
quiz.en: Try not to chat with passengers while driving so you don't get distracted.

取代.gloss: to replace; to take the place of; to supersede

example.zh: 有人担心将来机器人会取代人类的很多工作。
example.en: Some people worry that robots will take over many human jobs in the future.

quiz.zh: 智能手机几乎已经取代了数码相机。
quiz.en: Smartphones have all but replaced digital cameras.

example.zh: 飞行员在正式开飞机之前，要在模拟器上练习很长时间。
example.en: Before flying for real, pilots practice for a long time on a simulator.

quiz.zh: 考试前一周，老师给我们组织了一次模拟考试。
quiz.en: A week before the exam, the teacher gave us a mock exam.

example.zh: 这药片太大了，我怎么也吞不下去。
example.en: This pill is too big; I just can't swallow it.

quiz.zh: 蛇能把比自己的头大好几倍的动物整个吞下去。
quiz.en: A snake can swallow whole an animal several times larger than its own head.

example.zh: 这张照片只能看到他的背影，看不到正面。
example.en: In this photo you can only see him from behind, not his front.

quiz.zh: 这次活动在社会上产生了很大的正面影响。
quiz.en: This event had a big positive impact on society.

毫不.gloss: not at all; not in the least

example.zh: 他毫不犹豫地跳进河里，救起了那个孩子。
example.en: Without the slightest hesitation he jumped into the river and saved the child.

quiz.zh: 面对记者的提问，她毫不客气地指出了对方的错误。
quiz.en: Facing the reporter's question, she pointed out his mistake without mincing words.

example.zh: 这件衬衫是纯棉的，穿起来很舒服。
example.en: This shirt is pure cotton and very comfortable to wear.

quiz.zh: 这个地区气候干燥、阳光充足，很适合种棉花。
quiz.en: This region is dry and sunny, ideal for growing cotton.

顾.gloss: to attend to, to take care of; to look after; to consider

example.zh: 他工作太忙，根本顾不上家里的事。
example.en: He's so busy at work that he has no time at all to attend to things at home.

quiz.zh: 她只顾着玩手机，连饭都忘了吃。
quiz.en: She was so absorbed in her phone that she even forgot to eat.

example.zh: 新任中国驻美国大使今天抵达华盛顿。
example.en: The new Chinese ambassador to the United States arrived in Washington today.

quiz.zh: 这位著名演员被任命为这次环保活动的形象大使。
quiz.en: This famous actor has been appointed ambassador for the environmental campaign.

打造.gloss: to create; to build; to forge

example.zh: 这座城市正在努力打造国际旅游中心。
example.en: The city is working hard to build itself into an international tourism center.

quiz.zh: 他花了十年时间，把一家小餐馆打造成了全国知名的连锁品牌。
quiz.en: Over ten years, he built a small restaurant into a nationally famous chain.

得以.gloss: to be able to; so that (something) can; to get to

example.zh: 在大家的帮助下，这个问题终于得以解决。
example.en: With everyone's help, the problem was finally resolved.

quiz.zh: 由于及时送到了医院，病人的生命得以保住。
quiz.en: Because he was taken to hospital in time, the patient's life was saved.

上市.gloss: to go public (on the stock market); to come on the market
上市.indonesian: melantai di bursa; mulai dijual di pasaran

example.zh: 这家公司计划明年在香港上市。
example.en: This company plans to list in Hong Kong next year.

quiz.zh: 每年五月，新鲜的荔枝就开始上市了。
quiz.en: Every May, fresh lychees start to appear on the market.

猜测.gloss: to guess; to speculate; guess, speculation

example.zh: 大家都在猜测他为什么突然辞职。
example.en: Everyone is speculating about why he suddenly quit.

quiz.zh: 这只是我的猜测，还没有得到证实。
quiz.en: This is just my guess; it hasn't been confirmed.

example.zh: 由于下雨，比赛场地临时改到了室内体育馆。
example.en: Because of the rain, the venue was moved to the indoor gym at short notice.

quiz.zh: 学校的运动场地不够大，学生们只能轮流上体育课。
quiz.en: The school's sports grounds aren't big enough, so students have to take turns having PE.

伤亡.gloss: casualties; to be injured or killed

example.zh: 这次交通事故造成了三人伤亡。
example.en: This traffic accident left three people killed or injured.

quiz.zh: 幸运的是，这场大火没有造成人员伤亡。
quiz.en: Fortunately, the fire caused no casualties.

example.zh: 这家超市的特价鸡蛋每人限买两盒。
example.en: The supermarket's discounted eggs are limited to two boxes per person.

quiz.zh: 这次作文比赛每篇限八百字以内，超出的要扣分。
quiz.en: In this essay contest each entry is limited to 800 characters; anything over loses points.

example.zh: 她在这届奥运会上一共拿了三枚金牌。
example.en: She won three gold medals at these Olympics.

quiz.zh: 这位老运动员终于在退役前夺得了人生第一块金牌。
quiz.en: This veteran athlete finally won the first gold medal of his career before retiring.

example.zh: 酒后开车的司机将受到严厉处罚。
example.en: Drivers caught drink-driving will be severely punished.

quiz.zh: 学校对考试作弊的学生进行了处罚。
quiz.en: The school punished the students who cheated in the exam.

开启.gloss: to open; to start; to usher in

example.zh: 大学毕业后，他开启了人生的新阶段。
example.en: After graduating from university, he began a new chapter in his life.

quiz.zh: 这扇门需要刷员工卡才能开启，外人是进不去的。
quiz.en: This door only opens with a staff card; outsiders can't get in.

example.zh: 这孩子学习很用心，成绩一直在班里前几名。
example.en: This child studies very diligently and is always among the top in the class.

quiz.zh: 这份礼物虽然不贵，但看得出来他是用心准备的。
quiz.en: This gift isn't expensive, but you can tell he put a lot of thought into it.

example.zh: 屋里太闷了，打开窗户让空气流动一下吧。
example.en: It's too stuffy in here; open the window and let some air circulate.

quiz.zh: 现在年轻人换工作越来越频繁，人才流动也越来越快。
quiz.en: Young people change jobs more and more often these days, so talent moves around faster and faster.

example.zh: 他最喜欢看喜剧，每次都笑得停不下来。
example.en: He loves watching comedies and can never stop laughing.

quiz.zh: 这部电影虽然是喜剧，结尾却让很多观众哭了。
quiz.en: Although the film is a comedy, its ending made many viewers cry.

example.zh: 这部电影的画面非常漂亮，给观众带来了强烈的视觉冲击。
example.en: The film's imagery is gorgeous and makes a strong visual impact on audiences.

quiz.zh: 长时间盯着电脑屏幕，容易造成视觉疲劳。
quiz.en: Staring at a computer screen for a long time can easily cause eye strain.

example.zh: 她身上的香水味很淡，闻起来很舒服。
example.en: Her perfume is very light and pleasant to smell.

quiz.zh: 我在机场的免税店给妈妈买了一瓶香水。
quiz.en: I bought my mom a bottle of perfume at the airport duty-free shop.

救助.gloss: to help (people in need); to rescue; aid

example.zh: 这个组织专门救助街头的流浪动物。
example.en: This organization specializes in rescuing stray animals off the streets.

quiz.zh: 政府设立了专项资金，用来救助生活困难的家庭。
quiz.en: The government has set up a special fund to help families in hardship.

汇.gloss: to remit (money); to converge, to flow together

example.zh: 他每个月都会给家里汇一些钱。
example.en: Every month he sends some money home.

quiz.zh: 几条小河在这里汇成了一条大河。
quiz.en: Several streams converge here to form a big river.

example.zh: 下周的会议，请你和王经理一同参加。
example.en: Please attend next week's meeting together with Manager Wang.

quiz.zh: 毕业那天，全班同学一同在校门口拍了合影。
quiz.en: On graduation day, the whole class took a group photo together at the school gate.

example.zh: 这家珠宝店里的钻石项链价格都非常高。
example.en: The diamond necklaces in this jewelry store are all very expensive.

quiz.zh: 小偷趁主人不在，偷走了家里所有的珠宝首饰。
quiz.en: While the owners were away, the thief stole all the jewelry in the house.

赖.gloss: to rely on, to depend on; to hang on, to refuse to leave; bad (in 'not bad')
赖.indonesian: bergantung; bermalas-malasan, enggan beranjak; jelek (dalam ungkapan "tidak jelek")

example.zh: 你做的菜真不赖，比饭馆的还好吃。
example.en: Your cooking is really not bad; it's even better than the restaurant's.

quiz.zh: 周末早上他总爱赖在床上，到中午才起来。
quiz.en: On weekend mornings he likes to lie in bed and doesn't get up until noon.

愁.gloss: to worry; to be anxious; sorrow

example.zh: 找不到工作，他愁得好几天都睡不着觉。
example.en: Unable to find a job, he was so worried that he couldn't sleep for days.

quiz.zh: 他家里有钱，从来不用为吃穿发愁。
quiz.en: His family is wealthy, so he has never had to worry about food or clothing.

example.zh: 生活在大都市里的人，工作压力普遍比较大。
example.en: People living in big cities generally face a lot of work pressure.

quiz.zh: 这部电视剧讲述了几个年轻人在都市里打拼的故事。
quiz.en: This TV drama tells the story of a few young people trying to make it in the city.

专用.gloss: for a special purpose; dedicated; exclusive

example.zh: 这条车道是公交车专用的，其他车辆不能进入。
example.en: This lane is reserved for buses; other vehicles may not enter.

quiz.zh: 这是残疾人专用的停车位，请不要随便占用。
quiz.en: This is a disabled parking space; please do not park in it.

example.zh: 目前，汽油仍然是大多数汽车使用的燃料。
example.en: At present, gasoline is still the fuel most cars run on.

quiz.zh: 过去农村做饭主要用木柴当燃料。
quiz.en: In the past, rural households mostly used firewood as fuel for cooking.

认同.gloss: to identify with; to approve of; to accept
认同.indonesian: setuju; mengakui; merasa menjadi bagian dari

example.zh: 我很认同你的看法，学习确实比分数重要。
example.en: I really agree with you; learning is indeed more important than grades.

quiz.zh: 很多海外华人对中国文化有很强的认同感。
quiz.en: Many overseas Chinese identify strongly with Chinese culture.

思路.gloss: train of thought; line of thinking; approach

example.zh: 他写文章思路很清楚，读起来一点儿也不累。
example.en: His writing is very clearly thought out and easy to read.

quiz.zh: 你突然打断我，我的思路全乱了。
quiz.en: You interrupted me so suddenly that I completely lost my train of thought.

example.zh: 他爸爸对他要求很严，每天都要检查他的作业。
example.en: His father is very strict with him and checks his homework every day.

quiz.zh: 这家公司管理很严，上班迟到一次就要扣钱。
quiz.en: This company is strictly managed; being late even once means a pay deduction.

example.zh: 这双鞋的尺寸有点儿小，能给我换一双大一点儿的吗？
example.en: These shoes are a bit small; could I exchange them for a bigger pair?

quiz.zh: 买家具之前，最好先量好房间的尺寸。
quiz.en: Before buying furniture, it's best to measure the room first.

example.zh: 我们沿着海岸开车，一路上风景美极了。
example.en: We drove along the coast, and the scenery was gorgeous the whole way.

quiz.zh: 台风即将登陆，海岸附近的居民都已经转移。
quiz.en: The typhoon is about to make landfall, and residents near the coast have all been evacuated.

通话.gloss: to talk on the phone; phone call

example.zh: 我刚才和妈妈通话的时候，她说家里一切都好。
example.en: When I spoke to Mom on the phone just now, she said all is well at home.

quiz.zh: 开车时用手机通话非常危险。
quiz.en: Talking on your phone while driving is very dangerous.

担忧.gloss: to worry; to be anxious; concern

example.zh: 父母对孩子的未来感到担忧。
example.en: The parents are worried about their child's future.

quiz.zh: 专家担忧，持续的高温天气可能会影响今年的粮食产量。
quiz.en: Experts worry that the continuing heat could affect this year's grain harvest.

赞同.gloss: to agree with; to approve of; to endorse

example.zh: 大多数人都赞同这个方案，只有两个人反对。
example.en: Most people approve of this plan; only two are against it.

quiz.zh: 对于周末加班的提议，全组只有他一个人举手赞同。
quiz.en: Of the whole team, he was the only one who raised his hand in favor of the proposal to work weekends.

融合.gloss: to blend; to merge; to fuse

example.zh: 这家餐厅的菜融合了中西方的特点。
example.en: This restaurant's dishes blend Chinese and Western styles.

quiz.zh: 这座城市的建筑风格把传统和现代很好地融合在了一起。
quiz.en: The city's architecture blends the traditional and the modern beautifully.

example.zh: 考试前几天，他变得很焦虑，晚上总是睡不好。
example.en: In the days before the exam, he became very anxious and slept badly every night.

quiz.zh: 孩子回家晚了也不打电话，妈妈在家里焦虑地等着。
quiz.en: The child was late home and hadn't called, so the mother waited anxiously at home.

example.zh: 这个钉子钉得很牢，怎么拔也拔不出来。
example.en: This nail is in so firmly that no matter how you pull, it won't come out.

quiz.zh: 他年轻时因为抢劫坐了五年牢，出来后决心重新做人。
quiz.en: As a young man he served five years in prison for robbery, and after his release he resolved to turn over a new leaf.

避.gloss: to avoid; to shelter from; to keep away from

example.zh: 突然下起了大雨，我们赶紧跑到屋檐下避雨。
example.en: It suddenly started pouring, and we rushed under the eaves to shelter from the rain.

quiz.zh: 他最近好像在故意避着我，打电话也不接。
quiz.en: He seems to be deliberately avoiding me lately; he won't even answer my calls.

example.zh: 多吃蔬菜和水果，有利于肠道健康。
example.en: Eating plenty of vegetables and fruit is good for gut health.

quiz.zh: 他最近肠胃不好，吃点儿凉的就拉肚子。
quiz.en: His stomach has been bad lately; eating anything cold gives him diarrhea.

预定.gloss: to schedule, to fix in advance; to book, to reserve

example.zh: 我们已经预定了周六晚上的餐厅。
example.en: We've already booked the restaurant for Saturday evening.

quiz.zh: 由于天气原因，飞机没能按预定时间起飞。
quiz.en: Because of the weather, the plane couldn't take off at the scheduled time.

example.zh: 地球是我们共同的家园，每个人都应该保护它。
example.en: The Earth is our shared home, and everyone should protect it.

quiz.zh: 战争让成千上万的人失去了家园。
quiz.en: The war left tens of thousands of people without a home.

清洗.gloss: to wash; to clean; to rinse

example.zh: 新买的水果最好先清洗干净再吃。
example.en: It's best to wash newly bought fruit thoroughly before eating it.

quiz.zh: 空调用了一个夏天，应该请人来清洗一下了。
quiz.en: After a whole summer of use, the air conditioner should be cleaned by a professional.

上台.gloss: to go up on stage; to come to power

example.zh: 轮到他上台演讲时，他紧张得手都在抖。
example.en: When it was his turn to go up and give a speech, he was so nervous his hands were shaking.

quiz.zh: 颁奖典礼上，获奖的同学一个个上台领奖。
quiz.en: At the awards ceremony, the winning students went up on stage one by one to collect their prizes.

example.zh: 二氧化碳是一种无色无味的气体。
example.en: Carbon dioxide is a colorless, odorless gas.

quiz.zh: 工厂排放的有毒气体对附近居民的健康造成了威胁。
quiz.en: Toxic gases emitted by the factory pose a threat to the health of nearby residents.

渡.gloss: to cross (a river or sea); to ferry; to get through (a hard time)

example.zh: 过去没有桥的时候，人们只能坐船渡河。
example.en: In the past, before there was a bridge, people could only cross the river by boat.

quiz.zh: 在大家的帮助下，他们一家终于渡过了难关。
quiz.en: With everyone's help, the family finally got through their difficulties.
